tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: :gsang thig snying po'i skor las: bla sgrub 'od kyi thig le bzhugs so: :

rig 'dzin bla ma'i sku la 'dud: gdod nas rnam par dag pa yi: chos sku thig le nyag gcig las: longs spyod yongs rdzogs rigs lnga'i sprin: kha sbyor bde ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: de las so sor rtog pa yi: ye shes rig mdangs pad+ma'i gtso: 'chi med 'od mtha' yas par shar: snying rjes 'khor ba dong sprugs phyir: thugs rje chen po'i rnam par snang: bye brag mi mjed 'dzam gling gi: gdul bya thun mong snang ngo ru: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang: dha na ko ṣar brdzus te 'khrungs: bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i rnam rol gyis: rgya gar rgya nag bod dang li: lho nub srin yul tshun chad du: ngo mtshar cho 'phrul brjod mi langs: de dag rnam pa rjes mthun pa'i: sngon med thugs sgrub snying po'i bcud: gu ru rje la lung zhus nas: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag nyid kyis: mkha' 'gro'i brda yi yi ger btab: rin chen brag la gter du gtams: ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i dus: bdag gis byin brlabs rig 'dzin ni: bai ro chos rgyal skye ba'i mtha': de dag rnams dang 'phrad nas kyang: bod khams phan bde'i btsas su shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'di la spyi don gsum yin te: sgrub pa'i thabs dang khrid rim dang: slob ma smin par byed pa 'o: sgrub thabs las kyi rim pa la: sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyis bstan: sbyor ba rten mchod bsham pa dang: cho ga dngos kyi las rim mo: dang po rten mchod bsham pa ni: gu ru dngos kyi sgrub gnas sogs: dben zhing byin rlabs zil ldan sar: tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i dus sogs su: sku gsung thugs rten khyad par dang: maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs sam: yang na dpal gyi gtor chen bkod: sman gtor rak+ta tshogs mchod dang: phyi nang mchod pa thams cad kun: bag dro brjid dang ldan par bsham: bde ba'i stan 'dug lus gnad bsrang: rlung ro bsal zhing rnam rtog gi: spros pa'i 'ching ba gzhan bcad nas:

rtse gcig ting 'dzin bsgom par bya: gnyis pa cho ga'i las rim la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa smon 'jug sems bskyed ni: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca 'o: gsum pa bsod nams tshogs gsog ni: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: gsang sngags bsgrubs la rjes yi rang: smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: snying po sems can don du bsngo: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ni:hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang: yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ṭa ya phaṭa: lnga pa srung mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang: bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa: drug pa byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gnas 'dir thugs rjes brtser dgongs la: dbang skur byin phob dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya ā we sha ya a ā: bdun pa mchod tshogs byin rlabs ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ye shes rig rtsal me rlung chus: mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus: gnas yul dag pa'i zhing gi dbus: kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur:

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da ghan+dhe ra sa spar+she ma hā sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: sbyor ba'i las rim rnam bdun no: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las bdun las: dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni: aḥ skye med spros bral de bzhin nyid: bden gnyis dbyer med 'od gsal ngang: kun snang snying rje sgyu ma'i tshul: dmigs med mkha' khyab kun tu brdal: stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rtsal: thams cad skyed byed rgyu yi hūm̐: mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar: de las 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: snod bcud gzung 'dzin stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: 'byung lnga yum gyi mkha' klong brtsegs: rin chen ri dbang lhun mthor 'phags: de steng rdo rje'i srung 'khor dbus: rang byung lhun grub gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang: drwa ba drwa phyed shar bus brgyan: dbus phyur rdo rje nor bu'i tog: phyi gsal nang gsal 'od lnga'i klong: pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba ru: seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan: de steng hūm̐ yig yongs gyur las: bde chen ngo bo nyid kyi sku: rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum sgeg: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag phyag rgya'i steng: bde stong bdud rtsi'i thod zhal bsnams: gsang gos phod ka chos gos dang: za 'og ber chen mdzes par bklubs: dbu la pad+ma'i snyan zhus brjid: spyan zlum lta stangs hrig ger gzigs: zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gis: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na rol: thugs kar chu skyes nyi zla'i steng: chos sku mi 'gyur gsang ba 'dus: mthing gsal rdo rje dril bu'i rgyas: rang 'od mtsho rgyal dkar mo 'khril: gnyis ka dar dang rin chen dang: rus pa me tog phreng bas brgyan:

rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung gis: snyoms 'jug mchog gi bde bas rol: phyi 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: longs spyod yongs rdzogs ye shes sku: shar du bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: dkar gsal 'khor lo dril bu bsnams: lho ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal: gser mdangs rin chen dril bu 'dzin: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dmar gsal pad+ma dril bu bsnams: byang du karma thod phreng rtsal: ljang nag rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: kun kyang dar dang rin chen dang: rus pa'i rgyan ldan skyil krung gis: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rang 'od rig ma'i bde bas dgyes: shar lho 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i rtsal: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje dkar: rdo rje thod 'dzin phyed skyil bzhugs: lho ru rgyal sras thor tshugs can: pad+ma'i rgyal po dmar mdangs brjid: yid bzhin nor bu gser 'khor bsnams: nub byang shān+ta rak+ṣi ta: dmar smug kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag rol: khro chags rig 'dzin brtul zhugs spyod: byang shar shāka seng blo ldan mchog: gser mdog sprul sku'i cha byad can: sa gnon mnyam gzhag mtshan dpes brgyan: de phyir rin chen zur brgyad la: shar du 'chi med pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar rdo rje tshe bum 'dzin: man+dā ra ba yum dang sbyor: lho ru pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: dmar smug khro 'dzum rjes chags nyams: rigs kyi yum 'khyud rdor dril bsnams: nub tu seng ge sgra sgrog mthing: rdo rje gsor zhing sdigs mdzub sgreng: dur khrod rol pa'i chas kyis brjid: byang du gu ru mkha' lding mthing: sdigs mdzub dang bcas rdor dril 'phyar: rin chen rus rgyan gar thabs bsgyur: shar lhor bde chen nyi ma 'od: gser mdangs gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer thod chang rol: lho nub rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rdor dril bsnams: phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes grub: nub byang pad+ma saṃ bhā wa: dkar dmar rdo rje thod pa 'dzin:

dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i tshul: byang shar lhun grub gro bo lod: rdo rje gsor zhing phur bu 'dril: khro bo 'chol ba'i cha byad 'chang: kun kyang rang rang zhi khro'i nyams: rgyan dang cha lugs rnam 'gyur rdzogs: gang 'dul ma 'gag rol pa'i gar: 'ja' 'od me phung klong du gsal: sgo bzhir dpa' bo rigs bzhi ni: dkar ser dmar ljang zhi khro'i nyams: rang rtags phyag rgyas yum dang sbyor: zhing rkyang gdan la gar thabs 'gying: gzhan yang bdag skyob bla ma lha: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: steng 'og phyogs mtshams khyab par brdal: rig rtsal rol pa chu zla'i gzugs: bde chen gzi byin dpal 'bar bsam: gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan: rdo rje gsum gyi phyag rgyas btab: ye shes dbang bskur cod pan 'chang: sgrib dag nus rtsal yongs su smin: bde stong rol pa'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' khyab dkyil 'khor spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas 'dir: rig pa rang snang dam tshig par: dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes lha: gnyis med brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa gus pa'i tshul phyag 'tshal: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol:

yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma sku bzhi'i lha tshogs la: dngos bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: lha rdzas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: rang byung nang gi mchod pa 'bul: zung 'jug gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: chags bral rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma sogs: longs spyod rnam pa thams cad pas: dgyes mchod dam tshig nyams chag bskang: mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru bi d+yā dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+yā shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: pañca kā ma gu ṇa ma hā su kha pū dza ho: ma hā pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: dbyer med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa dzap kyi dgongs pa la: thog mar bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin ni: gtso mchog rdo rje thod phreng gi: thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: gsal zhing 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgyal ba yi: ye shes dngos grub bdag la thim: bla ma sku bzhi'i lha tshogs dang: dbyer med chen por byin brlabs bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas pa yis: bdag don byin rlabs nus thob 'gyur: snang srid phyag rgyar sgrub pa ni: slar yang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las: thugs rje'i 'od zer kun tu 'phros: khams gsum tha mal snang zhen sbyangs: ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i byin rlabs kyis: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che:

dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas 'grub par 'gyur: de nas las sbyor bzlas pa ni: thod phreng rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: las mthun 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: gang 'dul zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: shīn+taṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya rbad: khri phrag bzhi yis las byed 'gyur: 'di ltar sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: mthong thos dran reg thams cad kyang: pad+ma bdag gis byin brlabs pas: dngos grub mchog gi skal ldan 'gyur: sa ma ya: thun mthar rnam thar rjes dran blos: gdung bas gsol btab thugs dam bskul: khyad par tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: thabs shes dam tshig rdzas bshams la: bsang chu 'thor zhing bdud rtsis bran: ting 'dzin dgongs pas byin brlab bya: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rig rtsal rol pa me rlung chus: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin bag chags sbyangs: 'bru gsum 'od kyi 'phro 'du las: snod bcud dam tshig rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i ngang las longs spyod rdzogs: sprul pa'i rnam rol cir yang snang: rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: badz+ra sa mā dza: tshogs phud dang po mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi dam tshig ni: 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab: rmad byung tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: bar pas dam tshig nyams chag bshags: ho: bdag cag tshe rabs thog med nas: mi shes nyon mongs bag med pas: bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag kun: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod: tha ma bsgral bstab bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma khrag 'thung gi: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya yis:

dgra bgegs dgug bsgral zhal du bstabs: ye shes gzi byin bskyed du gsol: sarba duṣ+ṭan mā ra ya rbad: kha kha khā hi khā hi: spro na skong ba'i cho ga bya: nang du phung khams lha tshogs mchod: gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde chen spel: mthar thug rig stong dbyings su bzhag: lhag ma bsdus la bdud rtsis bran: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: pheṃ pheṃ: ye shes rol pa'i lhag sdud dang: las las grub pa'i pho nya'i tshogs: dpal gyi pham phab 'di longs la: 'khor srungs rkyen bzlog phrin las sgrubs: oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bla ma sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: dam tshig mchod pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: bsod nams tshogs chen rab rdzogs nas: ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog: rjes 'brel thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang rdo rje 'chang: longs sku thod phreng rigs bzhir bzhengs: sprul pa'i rnam rol cir yang ston: dbyer med bde ba chen por rdzogs: rab 'byams bla ma yi dam lha: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas dgongs: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: khams gsum dbang sdus dgra bgegs sgrol: rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol: 'od gsal thig le chen po'i klong: mchog dngos grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: srung mar tha tshig las bcol ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam can tshogs: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gtor ma dang: sman raka phud kyi mchod pa bzhes: sngon tshe zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la: bstan pa srung zhing rnal 'byor skyongs: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: shrī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bshal chus bod skyong mchod par bya: hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi bdag nyid che: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma'i tshogs:

'dir gshegs bshal chu'i bdud rtsi bzhes: bod khams bde ba'i phrin las sgrubs: ma ma dhā ki nī ba liṃ ta khā hi: mi ldog phyag rgyas mnan pa ni: hūm̐: khams gsum e yi dkyil 'khor du: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs mnan: rnam thar phyag rgyas yongs btab pas: nam yang ldang ba'i skabs med do: oṃ āḥhūm̐ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de ltar tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: rgyun dang dus su brtson pa yi: mchog thun phrin las rab 'byams 'grub: pad+ma can du dbugs 'byin no: sa ma ya: rjes kyi dang po gtang rag dbul: gnyis pa dngos grub gsol ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sku bzhi dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig rjes dgongs la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐: sgrub rten lhar gsal gnas gsum reg: dngos grub rdzas la rol par bya: gsum pa nongs pa bshags pa ni: ho: bla ma rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor du: ting 'dzin ma gsal bzlas brjod g.yel: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag kun: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: yi ge brgya pa brjod: bzhi pa 'od gsal dbyings su bsdu: a: rig rtsal lhar snang sgyu ma'i sku: 'od gsal dbyings kyi thig ler thim: bsam gyis mi khyab rdzogs pa che: ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: a a a: lnga pa zung 'jug lha skur ldang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: slar yang mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar: snang ba lha la grags pa sngags: dran rtog chos sku'i rol par shar: rgyun du 'gro ba'i don la spyod: badz+ra kā wā tsi rak+ṣa haṃ: drug pa bsngo smon rgyas gdab ni: ho: sgom bzlas mchod pa'i bsod nams sogs: dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas kun: byang chub snying por ro gcig pas: rang gzhan don kun lhun grub shog: bdun pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: ho: bla ma sku bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis: byin gyis rlobs pa'i bkra shis shog:

yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyis: dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can gyis: bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog: mchog dang thun mong phrin las kyis: rtag tu dpal gnas bkra shis shog: thun dang thun mtshams thams cad du: lha sngags chos skur lam khyer bas: rlung sems phyag rgyar smin pa na: rig pa 'dzin pa'i mchog 'grub bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub pa ni: tshe 'brang ril bu bdud rtsi sogs: ji ltar rigs pa'i rten bcas la: sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrangs dzap dgongs ni: hrī: thugs kar rdo rje thod phreng gi: thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor dkyil: rlung sems dbyer med srog gi hrī: dmar gsal sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas 'od 'phros 'khor 'das khyab: bdag gi bla tshe chad nyams dang: brtan g.yo srid zhi'i dwangs bcud kun: 'chi med bdud rtsir spyan drangs nas: thugs srog hrīḥyig gsos btab pas: bla srog dbang thang nyams pa gsos: rtag pa dam pa'i tshe dang ni: rdo rje'i ye shes 'grub par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bzlas thun mtshams tshe 'gugs bskul: tshe mda' g.yab cing gdung shugs bskyed: hrī: ngo bo 'od gsal pho brang nas: chos sku mi 'gyur gsang ba 'dus: rig rtsal 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs: ye shes chen po'i tshe bcud khug: rang bzhin bde stong pho brang nas: longs spyod yongs rdzogs thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs: rgyun gyis rtag pa'i tshe bcud khug: thugs rje 'gro 'dul pho brang nas: sprul pa'i rig 'dzin thugs dam bskul: pho nya mgyogs ma'i tshogs bcas kyis: brtan g.yo 'khor 'das tshe bcud khug: dbyer med gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: bde chen ngo bo nyid kyi sku: rig mdangs 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs: rdo rje gsum gyi tshe bcud khug: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang:

phyi snod nang bcud srid zhi'i tshe: rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la stims: rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol: rgas med lang tsho'i gzi byin 'bar: nad med bde ba'i nyams rtogs spor: 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi: dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol: sngags brjod spos bsreg rol mo 'khrol: mthar ni mi phyed phyag rgyas gdab: hrī: 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i bcud: mi shigs srog gi thig ler thim: rdo rje'i go khrab 'od 'bar bas: 'gyur med rtag pa'i rgyas gdab bo: badz+ra ā yu ṣe dz+nyā na rak+ṣa haṃ: de ltar rgyun du nyams blangs pas: 'chi med phyag rgya'i ye shes grub: bdun phrag gcig tu brtson pas kyang: tshe yi bar chad nges par sel: dngos nyams rmi lam ci rigs par: nyi zla shar dang bdud rtsi 'thung: phyag mtshan rdo rje rnyed pa dang: dngos su tshe zan brjid dang ldan: sgrub rdzas 'phel sogs rtags mthong tshe: dngos grub dga' ston rgyas par bya: sa ma ya: dngos grub nges par bsgrub pa'i phyir: rnal 'byor chen po'i las rim ni: bsnyen sgrub drod thob sngon 'gro bas: dben zhing nyams dga' yid 'ong ba'i: sa gzhi legs brtags rung shes nas: snang ba'i yul la rin gyis bcal: mi snang lha klu sa bdag la: gtor ma sbyin zhing bden pas bslang: las dang ting 'dzin mthu yis sbyang: yongs su bzung zhing bgegs tshogs bskrad: srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom: phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshams bcad de: dben zhing rang dbang gyur pa'i sar: stegs bu bzhengs shing chag chag gdab: me tog tshom bus mtshon pa la: skad cig lhar gsal snyan gsan dbab: gnang ba nod cing gshegs su gsol: bum pa slob ma lhag gnas sogs: ji ltar 'os pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs: de nas rdo rje'i thig gdab la: dkyil 'khor rdzogs par 'bri ba 'am: mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ci rigs dgod: khyad par sku dkyil bum pa dang: gsung dkyil myong grol ka pā la: thugs kyi me long sin+dhu ra:

sngags phreng bkod pa rim par brtsegs: yongs rdzogs dpal gyi gtor ma dang: gu ru'i sku 'bag dang bcas dgod: oṃ: bkra shis bum pa bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: ye shes dpag tu med pa'i rgyan dang bcas: dkyil 'khor dbus su brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: mi 'gyur sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sngags dbyangs mthar: kā ya dz+nyā na ka la sha sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: ā: rang byung bde skyong myang grol bcud kyis gtams: ye shes 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dbyig: dkyil 'khor dbus su brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: bde chen gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: wā ka dz+nyā na ka pā la a mṛta sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ā: hūm̐: dbyings kyi maṇ+ḍal rig pa'i dmar 'od 'tsher: zung 'jug rdo rje'i sngags kyi phreng ba bcas: dkyil 'khor dbus su brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: 'od gsal thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tsit+ta dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍa la man+t+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐: hoḥ gtor snod rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings su zlum: gtor ma rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: dkyil 'khor dbus su brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: rig pa rang snang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā sid+dhi ba liṃ ta dz+nyā na sa ma ya hoḥ hrī: ma hā gu ru bde ba chen po ni: sku bzhi dbyer med khyab bdag bla ma mchog: dkyil 'khor dbus su brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: rig rtsal ye shes dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā gu ru su kha dz+nyā na sa ma ya hrīḥ de ltar mnga' gsol gzi byin dbab: phyi nang mchod tshogs la sogs pa: bag dro brjid ldan mdzes par bsham: dbang thob dam tshig rnam dag cing: lam la slob pa'i sgrub pa po: ji ltar rigs pa gral du dgod: sgrub pa'i zhal bkod thems par gdab: phrin las gzhung bsrang rtse gcig tu: bskyed pa lha yi 'khor lo dang: bzlas brjod sngags kyi 'khor lo dang: ting 'dzin 'od gsal 'khor lo bcas: rgyun mi 'chad pas rab tu bsgrub:

bsnyen pa bdag mdun dbyer med la: sgrub pa'i dus su dzap khang dbye: dzap kyi phrin las bskul ba ni: oṃ: 'od gsal dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig pa rang snang phyag rgya'i gzugs: bla ma sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha: bzlas brjod dzap kyi phrin las mdzod: sku ni gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: gsung ni sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog: thugs mchog ye shes srog ldan pas: yon tan rol pa'i 'od zer dang: phrin las dag pa rab 'byams kyis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun: myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ting 'dzin rtse gcig bzla: stong stong tshigs su mchod pa 'bul: thun mtshams bgegs la phur bus gdab: ye shes gzi byin lhag par dbab: tshogs dang gtor ma rgya cher bya: rtags mthong rang don dngos grub blang: gzhan don dbang dang dngos grub sbyin: mtshams dgrol la sogs rjes chog dang: smon lam shis brjod rgyas par spel: sgrub chen 'di dang 'brel tshad kun: tshe 'dir tshe ring nad gdon zhi: ye shes gong 'phel rig 'dzin 'thob: phyi ma rnga yab dpal gyi rir: pad+ma bdag gis rjes bzung nas: mchog gi dngos grub myur du 'grub: skal ldan rnams kyis brtson par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: :zab mo khrid kyi rim pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo: dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni: dben zhing rang dbang 'du ba'i sar: bde ba'i stan la bag phab nas: lus ngag yid gsum rnal du dbab: dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla dang: las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam: nges 'byung mchog gis mtshams sbyar la: bslu med dkon mchog skyabs su 'gro: smon dang 'jug pa'i byang sems bskyed: 'gal rkyen sdig ltung sbyang ba'i phyir: rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: zhabs zung phyed pa'i skyil krung gis:

ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs: thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal: sngon byas las la gnong 'gyod dang: phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' bas: dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems: bdag la re ltos khyed las med: sdig ltung gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags: byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs: zhes pas gsol ba btab pa las: sku dang sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'phros: bdag gi tshangs pa'i lam nas zhugs: lus gang sdig ltung nad gdon kun: dag cing dri ma med par bsam: yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas brjod bya: bshags sdom gsol nas rang la bstim: mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir: mdun mkhar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gsal: mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud rab 'byams dang: bdag lus longs spyod dpal 'byor bcas: gzung 'dzin rnam dag 'od gsal ngang: bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum la: gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza ho: mthar ni spros bral ngang du bzhag: khyad par byin rlabs dbab pa'i phyir: zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom: a: gdod nas rnam dag gnyug ma'i gshis: rten 'brel sgyu ma'i snang cha las: snod bcud dag pa'i zhing khams dbus: rang nyid mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rjes chags nyams: gzhon tshul rin chen rus pa dang: dar gos me tog phreng bas brgyan: gri gug thod 'dzin dor stabs kyis: pad nyi bam ro'i gdan steng du: ye shes 'od zer 'phro bas 'gying: mdun mkhar seng khri pad zla'i dbus: rtsa ba'i bla ma pad+ma 'byung: zhi 'dzum dgyes nyams dkar dmar mdangs: rdo rje thod zhal tshe bum bsnams: gru mo g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ bsgrengs: pad zhwa chos gos ber phod gsol: zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

spyan drangs gnyis su med par bsam: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: yan lag bdun gyis tshogs gsog bya: mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab: bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid la: snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs: dbang skur byin rlobs dngos grub stsol: zhes gsol sngags kyis thugs dam bskul: thun mthar dbang bzhi blang ba ni: bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od zer rim dang gcig car byung: rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis: dbang bskur sgrib sbyangs ye shes smin: mthar ni dgyes pas 'od du zhu: bdag dang bla ma dbyer med ngang: gzung 'dzin spros pa las 'das pa'i: 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su bzhag: a a a: zhes brjod dgongs pa'i gding bzung ngo: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i khrid rim la: sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byor gsum: dang po phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor te: ting 'dzin gsum gyis gzhi bcas la: rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed: de yang dang po'i las can gyis: gtso mchog bde chen sku ru gsal: thun mong nga rgyal brtan por bskyed: khyad par gsal snang tshad du 'don: mchog tu dag pa dran pa yis: lha dang bdag dbyer med par bzhag: de goms dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la: sems 'dzin ting 'dzin rtsal sbyang bya: tha mal dngos po'i snang zhen kun: snang stong lha skur rang shar nas: 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'gog par 'gyur: gnyis pa gsung gi bzlas rim la: thun mong dzap dgongs gsal btab ste: bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshar phyin bya: khyad par rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni:

lus gnad bcos shing rlung ro bsal: nang 'jug oṃ gyi gdangs su drang: gnas pa āḥl zin yun bskyed: hūm̐ zhes phyi la nar gyis gtong: rgyu ba gsal sogs rtags mthong bya: mchog tu rlung rtsol 'gro 'ong gnas: sgra mtha' stong nyid 'od gsal ngang: rig stong gnyug ma'i phyag rgyas gdab: tha mal rlung dang sgra skad kun: grags stong sngags su rang shar nas: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub thob: gsum pa thugs kyi dgongs pa bskyang: thun mong rang nyid bde ba che'i: ye shes sku yi stong ra bsgom: rtsa gsum gsal btab rlung ro bsal: snying ga'i a wa dhū ti'i dbus: mi shigs thig le yungs 'bru tsam: dkar gsal 'od zer lnga ldan bsgom: 'jam rlung bum pa can dang sbrags: rlung sems thig le dbyer med la: rtse gcig sems bzung mnyam par bzhag: rnam rtog gang skyes thad kar bcad: g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin nas: shin sbyangs bde ba'i zhi gnas 'grub: khyad par phyi rol gzung ba'i yul: snang tsam nyid nas rang bzhin med: nang gi 'dzin rtog rtsad bcad pas: skye 'gag gnas med gnyug mar grol: bar du sems kyis ma bslad pa'i: sems nyid 'od gsal rang ngo shes: blo 'das rig stong rdzogs pa che: lhag mthong gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur: mchog tu dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i: ye shes brtan pa thob pa'i phyir: lus sems khong glod dal bar bya: mig gi gsang 'bras dbyings su gtad: chos nyid dran pas gsal btab la: rig stong spro bsdu bral bar bskyang: rnam par rtog pa gang shar yang: rjes su mi 'brang sngun mi bsu: da ltar rtsis gdab bral ba'i ngang: ma bcos ma bslad gnyug mar bzhag: rnam rtog zhi zhing ngo bo mthong: zung 'jug ye shes mngon du 'gyur: gsum pa rjes kyi khrid rim ni: thun rjes bsngo smon rgya yis gdab: thun mtshams tshogs drug lhug par spyod: go ba'i yid dpyod ci dgar bor: nyams la ma zhen yang yang bshig:

rtog pa rang thog ngo 'phrod pa: de nyid kho nar thag bcad cing: mi bsgom don dang mi 'bral bas: gzung 'dzin sbrul mdud bzhin du grol: dgongs pa de yi gding bzung bas: chos nyid rig pa mngon sum mthong: rang grol nyams myong gong du 'phel: snang sems ro gcig tshad la phebs: sgom med chos nyid zad sar 'khyol: shes dang shes bya dbyer med pa: zhi ba dam pa chos kyi sku: kun bzang pad+ma bde ba che: tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur nas: rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: snod ldan slob ma rjes bzung phyir: byin rlabs dbang gi rim pa ni: dben par mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor dang: bum pa la sogs dbang gi rdzas: phyi nang mchod tshogs brjid ldan bsham: bdag dang mdun rten dbyer med pa: sgom dang bzlas pas nus ldan bya: tshogs kyi mchod pas dgyes pa bskang: rang nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis 'jug: slob ma 'jug phyir gnang ba gsol: de nas snod ldan nges pa rnams: khrus nas dbyung zhing bgegs bskrad srungs: maṇ+ḍal dang bcas gsol gdab ni: bla ma sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor lha: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: zab mo'i rnal 'byor don gnyer bas: smin byed mchog gi dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum gsol gdab skyabs sems dang: tshogs gsag sdom pas rgyud bsdams nas: gzhi lus lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: brtan par byas rjes bum dbang ni: oṃ: spros bral chos sku'i bum pa zlum po ru: longs spyod yongs rdzogs ye shes bdud rtsis gtams: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i rgyan dang bkod pa bcas: dbyer med bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: ka la sha badz+ra a mṛta a bhi ṣīñca oṃ: gnas gsum bzhag cing bum chu sbyin: tshig don ngo sprod dgongs pa bskyang: bum pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par 'gyur: bhan+dha byang sems bdud rtsi thogs: ā: chos dbyings rang bzhin bhan+dha yangs pa'i klong: bde chen longs spyod bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil:

thugs rje sprul pa'i ye shes char 'beb pas: dbyer med bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro: ma hā ka pā la bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñca ā: gnas gsum bzhag sogs gong ltar bya: bsnyen sgrub las kyi bzlas lung sbyin: gsang ba'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par 'gyur: sin+dhu'i maṇ+ḍal sngags bcas thogs: hūm̐: chos dbyings stong gsal rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍa lar: bde chen longs spyod yongs rdzogs thig ler shar: rig rtsal sprul pa'i sngags phreng 'od 'bar bas: dbyer med bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro: maṇ+ḍa la ma hā su kha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gnas gsum bzhag cing thig le bya: tshig don ngo sprod bde stong bskyang: gsum pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs par 'gyur: dpal gyi gtor ma rdzas ldan thogs: hrī: gtor snod khyab brdal chos sku'i dbyings su zlum: gtor ma'i ngo bo longs spyod dam tshig rdzas: rol rtsal sna tshogs sprul pa'i rgyan ldan pas: dbyer med bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro: ma hā ba liṃ ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hrī: gnas gsum bzhag cing gtor rdzas sbyin: tshig don ngo sprad dgongs pa bskyang: ka dag dbang bzhi rdzogs par 'gyur: gu ru'i sku 'bag gnas gsum bzhag: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku skye med dbyings las longs spyod rdzogs: ye shes skur snang sprul pa'i sprin phung 'phro: rig rtsal don gyi dgongs pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dbyer med bde ba chen por dbang bskur ro: ma hā dz+nyā na kā ya ā we sha ya a bhi ṣiñca a ā: tshig don ngo sprod dgongs pa bskyang: rig rtsal dbang bzhi rdzogs par 'gyur: thugs dam rgyud bskul sngon 'gro bas: mtha' rten tshe 'brang spyi bor dgod: hrī hrī hrī: bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon tsaṇ+ḍa lī: o rgyan yab yum 'chi med rig 'dzin tshogs: dbyings nas brtser dgongs skal ldan slob ma la: tshe dang ye shes dngos grub bstsal du gsol: sngags mthar: badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yur sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

dngos grub dam tshig rdzas kyang sbyin: hrī: thabs kyi rang bzhin tshe yi ril bu la: 'khor 'das kun gyi dwangs bcud thig ler 'dril: mi 'gyur rtag pa dam pa'i dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes rgyas par shog: sngags brjod cing ril bu lag g.yas su sbyin: hrī: shes rab rang bzhin tshe yi bdud rtsi'i rgyun: 'chi med byang chub sems kyi dam tshig rdzas: rtsa khams bde drod 'bar ba'i dbang bskur bas: bde chen ye shes tshe yi dbang thob shog: sngags brjod cing tshe chang g.yon du sbyin: mthar ni rgyas gdab shis par bya: dam tshig khas blangs maṇ+ḍal sogs: rjes kyi rim pa spyi ltar spyad: zab mo'i dbang 'di bskur ba yis: pad+ma bdag gi ye shes byin: rtsa khams rlung la zhugs nas kyang: sgrib dag ye shes gong du 'phel: tshe gcig byang chub skal ldan 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: de ltar sku bzhi dbyer med pa: gu ru pad+ma saṃ bhā wa'i: thugs sgrub kun las khyad 'phags phul: ngo mtshar mchog gi rnam par thar: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i lam bgrod tshul: bcu gnyis mdzad par rjes mthun gang: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan pa: da lta mnga' bdag yab sras dang: bai ro mtsho rgyal lcam la sogs: nye ba'i 'dus pa rnams la bshad: rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshul du dbye: rgyas pa lha dbus snying drung dang: 'bring po lho brag phyogs su sbas: snying po 'od kyi thig le zhes: kha tshang don 'dril lag len bde: byin rlabs mngon sum 'beb pa 'di: de wī ko ṭi gsum pa'i gnas: rin chen brag gi sul du gtams: nam zhig sum cu'i dmar thag la: bai ros byin brlabs rig 'dzin gyi: dngos grub skal par thob nas kyang: gzhan la phan pa'i btsas su byed: dus kyi tha ma de yi tshe: 'di lta bu yi gdams pa'i phul: rab kyis bskyed rdzogs rtse gcig bsgom: rig 'dzin go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub: 'bring gis tshogs su sgrub pa 'am: tshes bcu'i dus mchod rgyun bzung na:

yul phyogs dge zhing byin chen phebs: snod dang bcud kyi rgud pa zhi: tshe ring nad med bsam rgu 'grub: tshe 'phos rnga yab dpal gyi rir: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshom bur sbyor: de phyir 'di la brtson par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: sprul pa'i gter 'byin rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi nor bu lo chen bai ro dngos byon o rgyan 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pas dpal spungs yang khrod de wī ko ṭi tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi mgul nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser las/

'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas dag par phab pa dge/ ༈ //khyab brdal chos dbyings rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes sgyu ma'i sku /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar mtha' yas pa// 'gro ba'i snang ngor ston la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku'i// theg mchog chos kyi bka' rnams ma lus pa// bsdu dang 'chad spel 'dzin pa'i skyes bu ru// lung bstan rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs 'di ru// sde gsum yi ge'i gzugs dang mdo sngags chos// gsal byed chos kyi spyan pa thu mi dang*// bai ro'i mtshan gyis gsal la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras rdo rje gling sogs zab gter sgo /'byed mdzad rim par byon nas da lta'i dus// gnas gter sgo phyes skal ldan smin mdzad pa// 'chi med g.yung drung gling par gsol ba 'debs// zab lam phyag rgya che dang chos drug sogs// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi khrid tshul gyis// skal ldan sku bzhi'i go sar 'god mdzad pa// karma yon tan rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// gsol btab thugs rjes bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// mgon po khyed kyi thugs rjes rjes bzung nas// gsang chen zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis// tshe gcig mchog gi dngos grub mngon gyur shog / ces pa 'di'ang gnas chen ma ṇi'i thang nas ma ṇi ba dpal sprul rgan pos gsol ba btab pa'o// //
